summary: Frontend regression after site-wide restyle (HomeNav/HomeFooter, IntroScreen, 6-card Work grid, /projects redirect). Nearly all specs pass. One minor spec deviation: /book uses a minimal `book-topbar` instead of the HomeNav (`main-navbar`), which contradicts the request wording ('/pricing, /book, /audit, /privacy all render with the new HomeNav — /audit uses a minimal topbar instead'). Everything else — homepage work grid (6 cards with real images under /work/mock/, 2-3 tag pills each), intro screen (progress 2→36%+, disappears within 5s, not re-shown on reload), /projects → /#work redirect + scroll, HomeNav/HomeFooter + hash-nav from /pricing, mobile 390 (no overflow, hamburger drawer, mobile-sticky-cta='Book a call' after scrolling hero), /audit minimal topbar + hero CTA scroll to form, /pricing visual (hero heading & £4,495 both present) — passes.

spec_deviations.issue: Uses a minimal `book-topbar` (brand + 'NOW BOOKING' pill only). Spec expected HomeNav (`main-navbar`) on /book — only /audit was supposed to use a minimal topbar. If intentional (focused funnel like /audit), add `data-testid='book-topbar'` to spec or expose Work/Services/Reviews/Pricing/Free audit links; otherwise swap in HomeNav.

test_evidence.homepage_work_grid: project-card-1..6 present with /work/mock/{edn,bespoke,citycivils,etn,aceofspades,rha}.webp (naturalWidth=1600). project-tag counts: 3,2,3,2,3,2. projects-all-link=None, projects-more-tile=None.

test_evidence.projects_redirect: /projects → https://.../#work, Work section scrolled into view (top=0, inView=true).
test_evidence.secondary_pages: /pricing & /privacy: main-navbar + nav-work + nav-pricing + nav-free-audit + nav-book-call + footer-section all True. /audit: audit-topbar + audit-brand + audit-back-to-website True, main-navbar absent. /book: main-navbar FALSE (uses book-topbar).
test_evidence.hash_nav_from_pricing: nav-work click → url ends with /#work. nav-book-call click → url ends with /#contact.
test_evidence.mobile_390: /, /pricing, /privacy scrollWidth==clientWidth==390 (no horizontal overflow). nav-menu-toggle opens nav-menu-drawer. mobile-sticky-cta present with text 'Book a call' after scrolling home past hero.
test_evidence.pricing_visual: Heading 'Websites that pay for themselves.' present. '£' + '4,495' present. CTAs render.

Previously validated end-to-end in iterations 6/7; backend POST /api/audit-leads reachable (422 on partial payload = schema active).
test_evidence.console: No console errors observed on any tested page.

action_items: Decide whether /book is intended to use HomeNav or its own minimal `book-topbar`. If HomeNav expected, replace the minimal top bar on BookPage.jsx with <HomeNav/>. Otherwise, update spec/doc to list /book alongside /audit as a minimal-topbar page.
critical_code_review_comments: /book uses a bespoke mini topbar (book-topbar) that duplicates part of HomeNav behavior; either reuse HomeNav for consistency, or extract a shared MinimalTopbar used by both /audit and /book to DRY the two funnel chromes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Set sessionStorage.jay_loader_seen='1' before navigating to '/' when the intro is not the thing under test. /book intentionally (or by oversight) uses a minimal `book-topbar` not HomeNav — flag only, do not fail the suite on it. Previous iterations (6,7) already validated the full /audit 10-step submission end-to-end; this iteration only re-verified the entry point renders after restyle.
